name: Alpencamping Mark
beschreibung: The campsite Alpencamping Mark is located in the municipality of Weer in the Tiroler Inntal. The surroundings are characterized by the Tuxer Alpen and the Karwendelgebirge. The atmosphere at the site is quiet. The sanitary facilities are modern. The site offers pitches for motorhomes and caravans with electricity connection. The infrastructure includes a bread roll service and a restaurant. Hiking trails and ski areas such as the Kellerjoch are nearby. The campsite is open all year round.
